identity_definition: SHA-256 of each task record canonical JSON using sort_keys=true,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=true plus one LF. Record binds task.toml, complete environment Git tree, container-definition hashes, and resolved external base-image digests.
method: Pinned Terminal-Bench task.toml blob + complete environment Git tree + Docker/container-definition blobs + registry-resolved external base-image manifest digests for linux/amd64. No solution/reference-answer files read; no agent/provider calls.
prebuild_note: A supplementary no-agent/no-provider prebuild audit was attempted. Resulting image IDs are not used as the primary expected identity because task builds may include mutable network/package-manager steps and cross-build bit-for-bit determinism was not established. Runtime-built image digest remains mandatory and must be identical across A/B/C/D for a task before provider invocation.
runtime_preflight_rule: Before any provider call, verify pinned Terminal-Bench revision, task.toml blob, complete environment Git tree, every container-definition blob SHA and SHA-256, and every external base image registry/platform digest against this packet. Any mismatch => CONFIGURATION_INVALID/INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID and ABORT_BEFORE_PROVIDER_CALL. Never silently rebuild from a changed moving tag after comparative execution begins. For a task, the runtime-built image digest must additionally be recorded and must be identical across A/B/C/D before provider invocation.
